title: Callbacks stop arriving after changing the retry interval
body: On Node.js 22.4 with relay-client 3.8, setting RETRY_DELAY=5000 makes the worker start. Actual result: callbacks stop after the first 429. Expected result: retry after the configured delay. To reproduce: set the variable, start the worker, then deliver a callback that returns 429.
recommendation_focus: reproduce the reported callback retry behavior; do not invent a file

title: Client import raises when optional adapter is absent
body:
### Machine
Alpine Linux, Python 3.12, client 5.1.
### What happens
ImportError: cannot import name 'Adapter' from 'transport'
### Steps I used
1) Create a clean virtual environment.
2) Install the base package without extras.
3) Import the client.

```text
2026-08-02T10:20:30Z ERROR lease lost
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address

example/worker.(*Runner).Run()
 /src/worker/runner.go:88
```
